column1: # Written for the Switch 2 merge: upstream played this game on a Mac; it has not been played on Android
# a hardware buffer takes all its memory at once, and 5 GB of them left a 12 GB tablet none (gfx_vk_core.c)
# the shaders are translated, so their code in memory pools goes back to the system (hle_nvn.c code_drop)
# a compute pipeline can take the driver over a minute: built beside the frame, not in it (gfx_vk_exec.c compute_async)
# handheld: the game picks its lower resolution and settings. Docked it asked more of the tablet than its memory and GPU have: under 15 fps in its first area, and closed by Android after 6 minutes
# the sticks float: hidden, and under the finger on its half of the window (front_android.c touch_event)
# the frame's Vulkan calls on a thread of their own (gfx_vk_dq.c): replaying takes 14 to 19 ms of a 40 ms frame
# one frame's passes in play, for the stripes on Ditto: remove with them
# the gamepad as in the player's picture (themes/pokopia, devtools/pokopia_hud.py). L3 and R3 are not in it: size 0, no touch
